manufacturer_spec_check.result: All fields match the register. Page states: Capacity 6 Qt / 5.67 L; 200-450 F; 13.38 x 11.81 x 10.63 in; 13.3 lbs; 1700W/120V; RJ38-SQPF-3TDB-2W; cETL, 1-year; nonstick dishwasher-safe baskets; dual viewing windows; Sync Finish; Hi-Fry max 450 F.

All published fields match the register. Page states: 26-Quart, 4-6 people, 24.6 Liters, 16.9D x 15.8W x 14.8H, 120 volts, 4-00675-02A-VN. Presets correctly blank: the page says '25 Cooking Pre-sets' while the Amazon listing title says 24 (FLG-024). New observation: the page description says '10-in-1' while an image alt on the same page says '11-in-1' - an internal inconsistency on the manufacturer page itself, extending FLG-024. No in-1 count is published by the register.

All fields match the register. Page states for the 8 Qt model: 8 Qt / 7.57 L; 200-400 F; 1700W/120V; 15.4 x 12.6 x 13.5 in; 12.8 lbs; RJ38-SQSS-8T; cETL, 1-year; 4 cooking presets; top-rack dishwasher-safe basket; auto-shutoff. The listing's 1000 W and 450 F title claims remain flagged (FLG-026, FLG-027) and are not published as specs.

All published fields match the F1 Ace family page: NIST-certified +/-0.5 F; 1-second instant read; thermocouple sensor; bright LCD; 100% waterproof design; built-in magnet; lifetime warranty activated within 30 days. The listing still does not name a model, so the family-page correspondence stays flagged (FLG-025).

DRIFT FOUND AND CORRECTED. S14 Specifications list two ranges: 'Internal temp range of 32 F to 212 F' and 'Ambient temp range of 32 F to 1,000 F'. S15 FAQ: 'The max temperature for the portion of the probe inserted into the food is 212 F... iQ Sense Gen 3 maximum ambient temperature limit is 1,000 F.' The register's Temperature row showed 32-1000 F (the ambient range) as the probe temperature. Corrected to 32-212 F (food range); the ambient rating is now stated in the lede. Probe 0.19 in x 4.75 in, 4 internal + 1 ambient sensor, USB-C hub, speaker, waterproof/dishwasher-safe probe all match. Battery correctly blank (S14 '70+ Hours' vs S15 'up to 60 hours' Gen 3, FLG-023). New observation: the S14 intro paragraph says 'Five internal sensors' while its Features list says 4 internal + 1 ambient; the register matches the Features list.
manufacturer_spec_check.drift: temp_max_f 1000 -> 212; lede now states the 1,000 F ambient rating; temp_max_f_note removed from blank_reason; correction block added to the P05 record

collector_test.what_was_tested: tools/collector.mjs run locally (PORT=8791, DATA_DIR in a temp directory) and driven with one request per defined event, then with four deliberately invalid requests.

results.request: outbound_click, path /shop/, product_id P01, destination_host amazon.com, placement shop-table

collector_test.stored_file: counts-2026-11-20.json, one row per event|path|property combination, counter incremented by 1 per accepted request
collector_test.verdict: The collector works. All five defined events are accepted and aggregated; malformed input is rejected and not counted; no IP address, user agent, cookie or identifier is stored.
collector_test.what_is_still_not_done: Nothing in this test puts the collector on the public internet. GitHub Pages cannot run a server, so analyticsEndpoint in data/config.json stays empty and the live site sends no events. Deploying the collector needs a host and an owner decision, and it is still FLG-009.

conclusion: One spec drift found (P05 temperature range) and corrected with sources S14/S15. All other published values re-confirmed against official manufacturer pages on 2026-11-20. No intended ASIN, confirmation date or official listing URL was set. No short link was declared valid or invalid.
